gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-shippori-antique: Happy Monkey draws every line with ruler-straight confidence, loud and a bit odd. Shippori Antique takes over for the paragraphs, a monoweight sans-serif with bowls tipped open, so pages of text move along easily.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-stick: Tubelike lines of constant weight make Stick read smooth, with exits wide enough to let light through. Stick takes the quiet seat while Happy Monkey, ruler-straight and bold, grabs attention above it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-suse-mono: SUSE Mono gives every letter extra room on both sides, with open curves that stay clear. And over a long page that spacing reads approachably, while Happy Monkey above it keeps its neon-tube look.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-titillium-web: Happy Monkey makes every curve as thick as its straight stems, a bold, ruler-straight line that sticks in the mind. Shrink it, though, and Titillium Web's far-apart stroke ends start to compete.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tomorrow: Happy Monkey's strokes all carry matching weight, bold and distinctive. Tomorrow, a sans-serif with bowls opening like a cupped palm, gives that loud heading a clean, quiet partner, and the difference between them is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Happy Monkey brings bold, ruler-straight lines and a distinctive streak up top. But Tsukimi Rounded, a sans-serif of round, parenthesis-like forms with parallel stroke edges, gives that loudness a soft landing, and that softness is the best thing here.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tuffy: Professional in manner, Tuffy looks sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, and its s is widely parted. Then Happy Monkey, bold and ruler-straight, sits on top and gives that restraint a louder voice.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-wix-madefor-text: Happy Monkey has a pipe-cleaner look to its strokes, bold and one of a kind. Wix Madefor Text answers with easy open terminals, and that gap between wiry heading and readable sans is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ysabeau-sc: Happy Monkey ends its terminals at the same width they began, bold and distinctive in a ruler-straight way. But Ysabeau SC, with a visibly gaping c at any size, brings a modern, professional quiet that makes the contrast the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-zalando-sans-semi: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded opens its curves on c, e, and s wide, and Happy Monkey above it looks like bent glass tubing. Its modern, professional text goes down smoothly.
